content.text: Skip to main content Naval History and Heritage Command Social Media Search Share Connect Close Battleships » Kearsarge (BB 5) » NH 52032-KN « Previous Next » NH 52032-KN USS Kearsarge Download Image: Low (PNG, 319x319px, 151KB) Med (JPEG, 1280x1280px, 252KB) High (TIFF, 3016x1824px, 16MB) Title: USS Kearsarge Description: USS Kearsarge (Battleship # 5) Postal card published circa the 19-teens, featuring a retouched and -tinted photograph taken off New York City during the October 1912 naval review. Colors applied to the ship's smokestacks and guns are quite inaccurate. In 1912 these would have been grey, not buff. U.S. Naval History and Heritage Command Photograph.
